name: Dreadtalon
introduce:
OS-09S Dreadtalon
One of Obsidian's high-performance light STs, developed based on the OS-06F Diana's combat data.
This ST is designed for precision strikes and excels at processing battlefield information, boasting a high efficiency rate in actual combat.
Equipped with the "Dominator" combat core, this unit can assist the pilot in completing a range of actions such as surveillance, positioning, aiming, and striking.

20154.name: Dominator Locator
20154.SpecificEffects: In combat, when Hit Rate exceeds <color=#F74848>70%</color>, each <color=#F74848>1%</color> above that converts into a <color=#F74848>25%</color> DMG Bonus, up to <color=#F74848>5%</color>.

30028.name: Execution Mod
30028.SpecificEffects:
When attacking a part with HP lower than <color=#F74848>60%</color>, DMG <color=#F74848>+18%</color>.
If a part is broken, trigger <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> to deal <color=#F74848>0.25x</color> DMG.
